name: Cw Enerji Muhendislik Ticaret Ve Sanayi A.s.
summary: CW Enerji Mühendislik Ticaret ve Sanayi AS manufactures solar panels, inverters, energy storage solutions and charging controllers. It offers solar power plant investment and technical consulting, projecting, system design, solar power plant installations, licensing and operation, as well as licensed and unlicensed production regulations for solar power plant project planning, designing, financing, implementation and general maintenance services. The company was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in Antalya, Turkey.
